worn_longsword.name: Worn longsword
worn_longsword.description: Your own blade. Nicked, honest and in need of a whetstone.

watchmans_edge.name: Watchman's Edge
watchmans_edge.description: A soldier's sword in better repair than its last owner. The watch sigil is still legible on the guard.

travelling_clothes.name: Travelling clothes
travelling_clothes.description: Wool and leather, patched at the elbows. Keeps the rain off, mostly.

watch_helm.name: Dented watch helm
watch_helm.description: An iron cap from the old garrison. Someone took a blow in it and walked away.

kite_shield.name: Battered kite shield
kite_shield.description: Oak boards under a skin of hide, rimmed in iron. It has turned a good many blows.

travellers_satchel.name: Traveller's satchel
travellers_satchel.description: A sturdy shoulder bag. Place it in an empty bag slot to carry more.

healing_draught.name: Healing draught
healing_draught.description: A small bottle of something bitter and red. Restores 42 health.

grave_iron.name: Grave-iron bar
grave_iron.description: A short bar of dark iron, cold to the touch and stamped with a smith's mark.

manifest.name: Carriage manifest
manifest.description: A carter's manifest, damp at the edges. The driver's name has been scratched out.

iron_gloves.name: Iron-studded gloves
iron_gloves.description: Thick leather with iron studs across the knuckles. Mara's own pattern.

hob_boots.name: Hobnailed boots
hob_boots.description: Heavy boots with iron nails in the soles. They grip a wet road.

mail_chausses.name: Mail chausses
mail_chausses.description: Riveted mail leggings, re-linked where someone was unlucky.

iron_shield.name: Iron-faced kite shield
iron_shield.description: Oak under a skin of hammered iron, brass at the rim. Heavy, and worth it.
